content:
It's MUCH easier if you remove the side acrylic and sheet metal panels at this time.

Also, make a decision about whether or not you want to use an alternate spool management system. The default spool holders and the filament sensor mounts will make it very hard to remove the side panels. IMO, this severely limits the serviceability of the machine in the future. I'm not say that it can't be done, I'm just saying it'll add more work than it needs to be.
